core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mubariz is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Warrior, fighter, one who duels”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mubariz corresponds to the Arabic form مبارز (Arabic root ب ر ز (b-r-z); مُبَارِز (Mubāriz)). Its core sense is warrior. Mubariz is Arabic مُبَارِز (Mubāriz) 'warrior, fighter, one who duels', from the root ب ر ز (b-r-z). The source gloss 'Brave and courageous' is broadly consistent.
